purpose: Verify the deterministic trust, dedupe, browser handoff, and availability boundaries introduced in M13.
scope_boundary: Offline deterministic fixtures only; no live-source recall or arbitrary-site browser compatibility claim.

cases.description: A concrete official page becomes a formally verified posting.
A careers guide is rejected without creating a posting.
Search snippets and inferred hints never become posting facts.
Repeated official discoveries share one posting and candidate.
A readable concrete job page is ACTIVE.
A first read failure becomes UNKNOWN, never CLOSED.
Three consecutive read failures become STALE.
Explicit closed-page text is required for automatic CLOSED.
A read-only browser snapshot follows the same verification boundary.
